init_ms_distributed: init MindSpore distributed environment with world size, rank, local rank, server args, and port
set_ms_parallel_env: set MindSpore parallel environment variables and spawn scheduler subprocess from init method
reuse_hccl_comm: reuse existing Torch HCCL communicator handles to create MindSpore communication groups
run_scheduler_init: run MindSpore scheduler initialization with rank, local rank, world size, master address, and port
get_host_and_ip: extract IP address and port string from a distributed init method URL
